attr.alt: Dr. Esam Nahlah, D.D.S., M.S., board-certified prosthodontist

nodes.v: , moving to Northern Virginia in 2013 to focus entirely on prosthodontics — esthetic dentistry, implant dentistry, full-mouth rehabilitation and smile makeovers.
In 2013 the American Board of Prosthodontics awarded him
status, the most prestigious credential in the field. He holds hospital privileges at
, the only Level 1 trauma hospital in Northern Virginia.

He has published in national and international scientific journals, lectures on smile design and dental implants, and teaches hands-on courses for other dentists — the kind of work that tends to bring the difficult cases to his door.
M.S., Master of Science in Oral Biology
Fellow, International Congress of Oral Implantologists
Associate Fellow, American Academy of Implant Dentistry

<style>*{box-sizing:border-box}*::before{box-sizing:border-box}*::after{box-sizing:border-box}</style><script data-embed="">
  WZ.add(function(W){
    if(W.reduced) return;

    var t = W.splitLines(document.getElementById('specTitle'));
    if(t && t.lines){
      gsap.from(t.lines,{yPercent:110,duration:1,stagger:.09,ease:'power4.out',
        scrollTrigger:{trigger:'#specTitle',start:'top 84%'}});
    }
    gsap.from('#specBio p',{opacity:0,y:26,duration:.9,stagger:.13,ease:'power3.out',
      scrollTrigger:{trigger:'#specBio',start:'top 82%'}});

    /* Credentials deal in one line at a time — the length of the list is the point. */
    gsap.from('#credList li',{opacity:0,x:-22,duration:.6,stagger:.07,ease:'power2.out',
      scrollTrigger:{trigger:'#credList',start:'top 85%'}});

    /* Portrait rises slightly out of its plate as the chapter passes. */
    gsap.fromTo('#specPortrait',{yPercent:6},{yPercent:-4,ease:'none',
      scrollTrigger:{trigger:'#specialist',start:'top bottom',end:'bottom top',scrub:.8}});
  });
  </script>
